issue: MPEGTS epoch chosen from a distant LOCAL header anchor could shift valid HLS captions by one or more 33-bit clock periods.
change: Resolve epoch after applying LOCAL-to-MPEGTS mapping to each cue, preserve duration and already-overlapping long cues; apply implicit zero mapping for HLS without a timestamp map.

checks.name: Distant zero anchor does not add a spurious MPEGTS epoch
Unwrapped cues preserve synchronization across multiple MPEGTS epochs
Distant nonzero LOCAL anchor is included before epoch selection
Wrapped PES with local cue clock retains existing behavior
Implicit zero timestamp map handles wrapped PES and unwrapped cues
Non-HLS subtitles retain their absolute cue clock
Boundary-spanning cue preserves duration and clips negative start
